name: Saren Arterius
reference_scope: First reference is a game render, cropped at torso. Second is the official full-body armor concept, reproduced in the official-art gallery. Lower-body details are concept-supported, not verified against a full-body final in-game model.
prompt: Edit this successful Saren character portrait to correct its viewing direction only. Physically rotate this SAME character into a FRONT-RIGHT camera view, so his face, nose, chest, pelvis and both toes point toward the RIGHT edge of the image. His long backward head spines must consequently extend toward the LEFT side behind his head. It must be instantly clear that he is looking to screen RIGHT. Do not horizontally mirror the picture: preserve his anatomical asymmetry, with the narrow pale-armored RIGHT arm on the camera-near side and the large dark mechanical LEFT shoulder/arm on the farther side, still visible. Keep exactly the same face identity, pale armor panels, dark tubes, blue lights, materials and complete equipped turian form, with no costume redesign. One calm standing figure with empty hands, full body including all head spines and toes. Reframe with generous empty space above the head and below the feet. Preserve the real transparent alpha background. No floor, scenery, shadow, lettering or effects.
